Preserve all other trigger/query/store order and the existing trigger-name restorations.

 if pos>=len(code) or code[pos]!='{':return

 while pos<len(code) and depth:
  depth+=(code[pos]=='{')-(code[pos]=='}');pos+=1
 return start,pos

cache={}

for r in queue['functions']:
 source=r.get('source');name=re.sub(r'\(\d+\)$','',r['name'])
 if not source or not Path(source).is_file():continue
 text=texts.setdefault(source,read(source));bounds=span(text,name)
 if not bounds:continue
 before=text[slice(*bounds)];code=mask(before)
 changes=[]
 for m in re.finditer(r'(?m)^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)if\s*\(event\s*!=\s*EVENT_CAN_CAST\)',code):
